children: RLI CORP reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $476.96M and diluted EPS of $0.88, as net income fell to $81.01M from $124.61M a year earlier amid higher catastrophe losses and mix shifts toward casualty lines.
Revenue was $476.96M for 3Q 2026, compared with $509.26M in 3Q 2025; YoY change (6.3%).
Net income was $81.01M for 3Q 2026, compared with $124.61M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change (35.0%).
Diluted EPS was $0.88 for 3Q 2026, compared with $1.35 in 3Q 2025; YoY change (34.8%).
Net premiums earned rose roughly 4% year-to-date, supported by growth in casualty business and a 3% increase in gross written premiums.
Mix shifted toward casualty lines — including personal umbrella and commercial transportation — increasing exposure to higher loss-ratio products.
RLI marked its 30th consecutive year of underwriting profitability, continuing to target niche markets with disciplined underwriting.
Investments in underwriting and technology increased expense ratios but are intended to expand capabilities.
Favorable development on prior-year reserves supported earnings, partially offset by higher catastrophe and storm losses in the quarter.
